Class Model

java.lang.Object
Amphipolis.Javadoc.Model
public class Model extends Object
The Model class represents the core logic, state, and data of the "Amphipolis" board game. It encapsulates the rules of the game, including player management, board state, tile bag operations, and score calculation. This class operates independently of the View and Controller, notifying them of changes indirectly or through state queries.

    • Model

      public Model()
      Default constructor for the Model. Initializes the basic structures required for the game logic (empty lists, null references). Pre-condition: None. Post-condition: A new Model instance is created with default null/empty states for players and game mode.

  • Method Details

    • getBoardTile

      public Model.ButtonTiles getBoardTile(int index)
      Retrieves a specific board tile object by its unique index. Pre-condition: The index provided must be within the bounds of the board list (typically 0 to 15). Post-condition: Returns the ButtonTiles object associated with that index, or throws an IndexOutOfBoundsException if invalid.
      Parameters:
      index - The index of the tile on the board.
      Returns:
      The ButtonTiles object representing that slot.

    • getBoardTiles

      List<Model.ButtonTiles> getBoardTiles()
      Retrieves the full list of all board tile definitions. Pre-condition: The board list must have been initialized statically. Post-condition: Returns the complete list of ButtonTiles.
      Returns:
      List of ButtonTiles.

      public Model.TilesBag getBag()
      Retrieves the game's tile bag. Pre-condition: The Model is initialized. Post-condition: Returns the active TilesBag instance.
      Returns:
      The bag containing all the tiles.

      public Model.Player getPlayer()

    • setGameMode

      public void setGameMode(String gameMode)
      Sets the game mode. Pre-condition: gameMode is a valid string identifier. Post-condition: The game mode state is updated.
      Parameters:
      gameMode - The string of the game mode.

    • SelectPlayer

      public void SelectPlayer(String cmd)
      Initializes the player list and sets the active player based on the game mode. Pre-condition: cmd must be a valid command string ("RandomPlayer", "NextPlayer", "OnlyPlayer", "ThievesTurn"). Post-condition: - "RandomPlayer": 4 players created, one random selected. - "NextPlayer": Advances to the next player ID (cyclic). - "OnlyPlayer": Initializes Singleplayer (Player vs Thief).
      Parameters:
      cmd - The command instruction.

    • DrawTiles

      public List<String> DrawTiles(String cmd)
      Handles the logic for drawing tiles from the bag at different game phases. Pre-condition: cmd is one of "RandomDraw", "PlayerDraw", or "ThieveDraw". Post-condition: - Tiles are removed from the bag. - If "RandomDraw": Tiles are placed on the board. - If "PlayerDraw": Tiles are given to the player.
      Parameters:
      cmd - The type of draw action to perform.
      Returns:
      List of Strings of the drawn tiles names.

    • PlayThiefTurn

      public void PlayThiefTurn()
      Executes the AI/Logic for the Thief's turn (Singleplayer). Pre-condition: Game mode is Singleplayer and it is the Thief's turn. Post-condition: The Thief "steals" (removes) remaining tiles from the board based on the landslide rules.

    • CalculatePlayerPointsAtGameOver

      public String[] CalculatePlayerPointsAtGameOver()
      Calculates the final score for all players to determine the winner. Applies complex scoring rules: Mosaics (colors), Sets (Amphoras), and Statues (Majorities). Pre-condition: The game has reached a "Game Over" state (e.g., bag empty, board empty). Post-condition: Returns a String array where: - Index 0: The Name(s) of the Winner(s). - Index 1: The numeric Score.
      Returns:
      String array [WinnerName, Score].

    • SaveGameStateAndExit

      public void SaveGameStateAndExit(int time, boolean btn1, boolean btn2, int[] board)
      Serializes the current game state to a text file ("cookies.txt") and prepares the application to exit. Pre-condition: The game is currently in progress. Post-condition: A file "cookies.txt" is written containing: - Current player, time, and button states. - Exact state of every player (tiles, cards, areas). - Exact state of the board and bag.
      Parameters:
      time - Integer seconds remaining in the turn.
      btn1 - Boolean state of the 'Draw' button.
      btn2 - Boolean state of the 'End Turn' button.
      board - Int array representing current board tile counts.

    • LoadGameStateAndStart

      public Object[] LoadGameStateAndStart()
      Attempts to read a saved game state from "cookies.txt" and restore the model. Pre-condition: The file "cookies.txt" must exist and be in the correct custom format. Post-condition: - If successful: Players, Board, and Bag are restored to the saved state. Returns an Object array with UI params. - If failed: Returns null.
      Returns:
      Object array [Time, Btn1State, Btn2State, GameModeString] or null.

    • ResetModel

      public void ResetModel()
      Resets the entire model state to default values for a new game. Pre-condition: None. Post-condition: The Bag is refilled, and all Board tile counts are set to 0.
